"Am I Wrong" is a song by Norwegian musical duo Nico & Vinz.
It was written by group members Nico Sereba and Vincent Dery, Abdoulie Jallow, and William Wiik Larsen.

The song was initially released as a digital download single in Norway on 12 April 2013, credited to the duo's previous name Envy, and became a hit in various Nordic countries, including Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland.
